title: Token-free research router: compute classes, Kaggle GPU adapter, capacity- and value-aware allocation
note: OPERATOR 2026-10-13 (voice, paraphrased by the manager): Claude writes the research unit (id + test structure); a dispatcher that uses NO Claude tokens sends each unit to the right compute by test kind and allocates resources toward the highest-priority, highest-value work; ready for planning Wed, running from Wed night. BUILD: scripts/research/research_compute.yaml (backends runner/trainer/kaggle/runpod, classes cpu_light|cpu_long|needs_vm_data|gpu|gpu_preferred, capacity, value formula, STRATEGY-REALIGN mix 30/25/20/15/10); scripts/research/compute_router.py (resolver + value score); dispatch_queue.py (class->workflow, per-backend capacity, Kaggle quota floor, value-ranked order within a theme, derivation on every line; dry-run default; explicit run.workflow still wins); research-script-run-kaggle.yml + kaggle_run.py + kaggle_unit/kernel_main.py (Kaggle GPU runner landing through the same collector); docs: PLANNING.md 1b + research-ops skill.
